extra_vocab.en: able to move quickly and easily
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 Nimble 是嬰兒推車的產品名稱（所以大寫），借用 nimble「輕巧靈活」的意思，暗示這台推車好推、好轉彎，行動自由。

example.en: Our new model is nimbler than the old one in tight spaces.
example.zh: 我們的新款在狹窄空間裡比舊款更靈活。

example.en: This is the nimblest stroller our team has ever tested.
example.zh: 這是我們團隊測試過最靈活的推車。

example.en: The wheels turn nimbly, even when the stroller carries a heavy bag.
example.zh: 即使推車載著重重的袋子，輪子還是轉得很靈活。

example.en: Assembly workers need nimble fingers to place the tiny parts.
example.zh: 組裝人員需要靈巧的手指來放置細小的零件。

example.en: A nimble company can change its plan quickly when customers ask.
example.zh: 反應靈活的公司能在客戶提出要求時迅速調整計畫。

example.en: We must stay nimble as customer needs change every season.
example.zh: 客戶需求每一季都在變，我們必須保持靈活。

examples.en: Our new stroller is called Nimble because it moves so easily.
examples.zh: 我們的新推車叫 Nimble，因為它移動起來非常輕鬆。

examples.en: The team needs a nimble design that fits small city apartments.
examples.zh: 團隊需要一個適合都市小公寓的輕巧設計。

examples.en: The folding bar makes the stroller light and nimble to carry.
examples.zh: 折疊桿讓推車攜帶起來輕便又靈巧。

confusable.diff: nibble 是「小口地咬」，和 nimble 只有一個字母不同，意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: nimble 是形容詞，nibble 是動詞（也可當名詞，指小口點心）。

example.en: Please don't nibble on the samples before the customers arrive.
example.zh: 客戶抵達前，請不要偷吃樣品。

confusable.diff: humble 是「謙虛的、簡樸的」，結尾發音和 nimble 很像，但和動作快慢無關。

example.en: The CEO gave a humble speech and thanked every employee.
example.zh: 執行長發表了謙虛的演說，並感謝每位員工。

similar.diff: agile 也是「敏捷的」，更常用在團隊或工作方式，nimble 較常形容動作或產品輕巧。

example.en: Our agile team released the update in just two days.
example.zh: 我們敏捷的團隊只花兩天就發布了更新。

similar.diff: flexible 強調可以調整、不死板，不一定表示動作快或很輕巧。

example.en: We offer flexible working hours for parents with young children.
example.zh: 我們為有幼兒的父母提供彈性工時。

example.en: We need a quick answer before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 我們需要在會議開始前得到快速的答覆。

example.en: The new stroller is light enough to carry upstairs.
example.zh: 這台新推車輕到可以直接扛上樓。

derived.link: nimble + -ness，變成名詞，表示「靈活的狀態」，像 kindness、happiness

senses.en: able to move quickly and easily

example.en: The nimble stroller turned easily around the crowded corner.
example.zh: 這台靈活的推車輕鬆轉過擁擠的轉角。

senses.en: quick to understand or to change
senses.distinguish: 形容手或動作時指靈巧；形容公司、團隊或思考時指反應快、調整快。

example.en: Nimble thinking helped the sales team win the new contract.
example.zh: 靈活的思考幫助業務團隊贏得了新合約。
